derivation: Original bounded implementation. The .class parser, constant-pool model, bytecode disassembler, findings scanner, and JAR walker are Turen-written parse-only code; JAR (ZIP) container reading delegates to the pinned zip crate with its pure-Rust deflate backend (flate2/miniz_oxide). The cafebabe and noak parser crates were evaluated and rejected in favor of a hand-rolled parser for tighter bounds control and a smaller dependency closure. No upstream CLI, filesystem, network, or execution APIs are exposed.
decompressionBounds: MANIFEST.MF inflate capped at 262144 bytes; a single selected class entry inflated at most to 33554432 bytes before parsing; decompressed output never leaves the module
